notes.title: v1.0.9 Patch
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25706108/7c5a458a99a1160276c845180787e5584ca63f66.jpg[/img]
Dear players, new patch is here!

* Engine Update
* Serious bug when you try to use jump in map mode has been fixed
* Several small bugs fixed
* You can hold mouse button for using pick axe (previous system require clicking every time) 
* Graphics bug fixed - glitch in indestructible walls indicator
